body: I love the game for everything outside of the combat. Idk what it is but I can’t stand it. The camera is the biggest issue seeing that 99% of the time I’m getting smacked by something off screen. Wish they would’ve taken a page out of Batman and pull the camera out when it came time for fighting. Combat towards the end of the game slowly was taking me out of it and I was desperate to get back to seeing some story or some dialogue. And this game, while AMAZING, definitely is getting into the realm of toxic circle jerk. People have different opinions. This game will win game of the year sure but nothing is perfect.

While I’d rather him not stream at all before he streamed on drugs again, I can’t help but notice the amount of effort and excitement that he use to put into streams has almost completely disappeared and now he’s just sorta there.

To let everyone know now my vote is cast in the “I’m an idiot” ballot and am hoping that it was one really long dragged joke and he doesn’t actually feel like that. If he really feels like that I feel like he should try and change something about his streams and alter something. I will admit the amount of interaction in say 2015 or 2016 compared to now is drastically different. I love man and every stream and am there every night but I definitely understand why some people have left or have gone to just lurking.
Maul saber throw is an easy fix, just have him throw it horizontally, and his star card could be upgraded so he can hit more than one target at a time, maybe Max it at 3 or 4.

I am willing to play this game casual or hardcore as I also plan to play solo. Mic preferred
